headline: Ghana Revenue Authority Targets GH¢237B in Non-Oil Revenue by End of Year
summary: The Ghana Revenue Authority expressed confidence in meeting its GH¢237 billion non-oil tax revenue target by December, citing traditionally strong receipts in the final two months.
why: Fiscal consolidation and revenue collection targets are critical benchmarks under Ghana's ongoing IMF economic stabilization program.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: The revenue authority is on track to achieve its annual non-oil revenue milestone of GH¢237 billion.
